explains: Three files change: services/billing/app/contests/replay.py, services/billing/app/latest_rates.py and services/billing/tests/test_money.py. The api test markers are the folder tests/ and the file-name prefix test_. They are matched by path segment (a folder segment equal to tests) and by file-name prefix (a name that starts with test_), never as a substring of the path. contests/ contains the characters tests/ at its end, but its segment is contests, not tests, so replay.py is a source file. latest_rates.py contains the characters test_ inside latest_rates, but the name does not start with test_, so it is a source file. services/billing/tests/test_money.py has the segment tests and a name starting with test_, so it is a test file. Nothing imports replay.py or latest_rates.py, so no caller is claimed.

must_exclude.why: contests/ is not a test folder: the marker tests/ must match a whole path segment
latest_rates.py is not a test file: the marker test_ must match the start of the file name
